title.purpose: The one page title in the top bar per screen.

label.purpose: Form field labels and table column headers.

body.purpose: The dominant 14px size used almost everywhere: table cells, cards, nav, buttons, inputs.

shadows.name: field
shadows.purpose: Text inputs, selects, searchable-select fields — reads as editable, not raised.

shadows.name: menu
shadows.purpose: Dropdown menus and searchable-select result lists.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: The modal panel — the one element genuinely interrupting the page.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default hover/active transition for buttons, nav items, table rows.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default call-to-action fill: Ink, not the accent — Runway Blue is reserved for links/active-nav/focus.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: #111827; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1f2937; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #030712; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ffffff, 0 0 0 4px #3b82f6; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bordered, white-fill counterpart for lower-emphasis actions (Cancel, dismiss).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; background: #ffffff; color: #374151; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f9fafb; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.25; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ffffff, 0 0 0 4px #3b82f6; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: #dc2626; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #ef4444; } .ds-btn-danger:active { background: #b91c1c; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ffffff, 0 0 0 4px #ef4444; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: The single field style used across every form: TextInput, SearchableSelect, and the QuoteOfferCard commission fields.
components.css: .ds-input { border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; background: #ffffff; color: #111827; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9ca3af; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #3b82f6; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #3b82f6; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Status pill. Five fixed variants (success/warning/danger/info/neutral) — status only, never a generic label.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-badge--success { background: #dcfce7; color: #15803d; } .ds-badge--warning { background: #fef9c3; color: #a16207; } .ds-badge--danger { background: #fee2e2; color: #b91c1c; } .ds-badge--info { background: #eff6ff; color: #1d4ed8; } .ds-badge--neutral { background: #f3f4f6; color: #4b5563; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The base surface for every dashboard widget, table wrapper, and mobile row fallback. Flat — border only, no shadow.
components.html:
Company Name

Acme Aviation SRL
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; background: #ffffff; padding: 24px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #111827; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-card-body { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 14px; color: #4b5563; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Desktop sidebar / mobile drawer navigation row. Resting on Night Ops Black, active fills solid Runway Blue.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; color: #9ca3af; text-decoration: none; background: transparent; transition: background-color 150ms ease-in-out, color 150ms ease-in-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav-item--active { background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; }

narrative.overview:
PremierSky Admin is an instrument panel, not a showroom. Every screen exists so one of a small, trusted team of brokers can do one job fast: read a quote, compare offers, price a contract, check a tail. The design has no persuasion to do and no audience to impress — it earns its keep in repetition, at a desk, many times a day, so it stays out of the way of the task.

The system is built almost entirely from two ingredients: near-black neutrals that carry structure and authority (navigation, primary actions, headings), and a single Runway Blue accent spent sparingly on the things that are genuinely interactive — active nav state, links, focus rings. Surfaces are flat by default; shadow is reserved for things that are temporarily floating above the page (a modal, a dropdown, a search menu), never for something that just sits there. Nothing about the interface itself is decorative — the one deliberately expressive mark is the black-and-gold aviation emblem in the nav, held apart from the functional palette as a fixed brand signature rather than a UI color.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, bordered surfaces; shadow signals "floating," not "important."
One accent color (Runway Blue), spent only on interactive/active state.
Near-black (Night Ops Black / Ink) carries visual weight instead of the accent.
Dual layout per data view: a real <table> on desktop, stacked swipeable cards on mobile — never a squeezed table.
Small, consistent type scale dominated by 14px body text; nothing shouts.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Runway Blue exists to answer "is this interactive, active, or focused?" — nothing else. Weight and hierarchy come from Ink and type size, never from adding a second accent.

rules.name: The One Size Rule
rules.body: 14px (text-sm) is body text everywhere — table, card, form, nav. Reach for weight (font-medium/font-semibold) or color (Ink vs. Text Muted) to create emphasis before reaching for a bigger size.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Rule
rules.body: If it sits in the page's normal flow (a card, the sidebar, the top bar), it gets a border and no shadow. If it floats above the page (menu, modal) or is a live control (input), it gets shadow scaled to how far above the page it sits.

dos: Do keep Runway Blue exclusive to interactive/active/focus state — links, active nav, focus rings, the selected-offer ring.
Do use Ink (#111827), not the accent, as the default primary-button fill; the accent is a signal color, not a brand color.
Do give every card and persistent surface a border instead of a shadow; reserve shadow for menus, modals, and live form controls (The Floating-Only Rule).
Do ship both a <table> (sm: and up) and a stacked-card view (below sm) for any tabular data screen — never rely on horizontal scroll or a squeezed table on mobile.
Do keep body copy at 14px (text-sm) and reach for weight/color before size when something needs emphasis (The One Size Rule).
donts: Don't pull Emblem Black/Emblem Gold into UI chrome — they belong to ApplicationLogo only, never to a button, badge, or status color.
Don't add a second accent color; new statuses or emphasis states extend the existing success/warning/danger/info/neutral badge set instead.
Don't put a shadow on a surface that sits in normal page flow (cards, sidebar, top bar) — if it needs to stand out, use the border or Paper/Surface contrast instead.
Don't introduce a new radius step; every clickable/editable element is 8px, every containing surface is 12px, pills are full-round.
